csv_project_name: Design for Ave 3 1/2E Widening (32nd St - 42nd St)
csv_scope_of_work: City of Yuma maybe seeking Design for This project will widen Avenue 3 1/2E between 32nd Street and 40th Street to a three-lane roadway to accommodate WB-67 vehicles with tandem trailers. Improvements will include construction of curb and gutter, storm drainage infrastructure, and intersection enhancements with dedicated right- and left-turn lanes and 65-foot curb radii to support large vehicle movements. A 10-foot multi-use path will be constructed along the east side of the roadway to provide enhanced multimodal connectivity.
